text:
Ibrahim: Following the KV-cache postmortem, I want a compact action table we can point at product and SRE. Keep owners + concrete verification steps.

Fiona: I can take sampling and baseline diffs. Plan: nightly heap dumps for top-5 shards and an automated diff job that highlights new top alloc sites. ETA: 48h.

Dmitri: I will own runtime guards and emergency behaviour. Short-term: add soft cap at 80% mem which triggers aggressive LRU, and hard cap at 93% which triggers node quarantine. Will draft PR today.

Claire: I'll do the fragmentation telemetry. Add fragmentation_ratio = 1 - (sum(used_chunks)/sum(allocated_chunks)) and a dashboard breakdown by prefix_size_bin. ETA: 72h.

Ibrahim: Great. Let's write 5 small actions we can mark off. Also want a recurring detection plan so this doesn't regress.

Fiona: Action-1 (Fiona) - implement nightly heap capture + diff job, push sample links to s3 and add to dashboard. Verification: three consecutive diffs show no new dominant alloc_sites. ETA: 48h.

Dmitri: Action-2 (Dmitri) - PR for soft/hard caps + quarantine workflow; include a canary deployment with soft cap only. Verification: canary runs 48h without eviction storms. ETA: 36h.

Claire: Action-3 (Claire) - instrumentation for fragmentation_ratio + prefix_size_bin tagging; add 7d retention metric and alert when fragmentation_ratio > 0.25 for 6h. ETA: 72h.

Ibrahim: Action-4 (Ibrahim) - add a quick unit/integration test that simulates eviction+compaction race (randomized schedule) and fails if RSS increases > 20% after N iterations. ETA: 96h.

Fiona: Action-5 (Fiona) - produce a 2-slide exec summary and a short customer-facing note template. Verification: slide deck and note in PR. ETA: 5 business days.

deploy-bot: canary started: kvcache-canary-9 (soft_cap=80%, slab_split=64K) - build 2026.5.03-rc7.

Dmitri: Hypothesis: fragmentation is amplified by many medium-lived allocations (~10-60s) interleaved with very large cold entries. I saw this pattern in the trace from 1968129999; will try slab binning by lifetime.

Fiona: Reproducer: small stress that allocates 1k-200k items with periodic compaction reproduces RSS creep. Snippet I used:
```
for i in 0..100000 {
  put(prefix(rand(1,1000)), payload(rand_bytes(1, rand(200000))))
  occasionally(compact())
}
```
I will add this to the test harness.

Claire: For alerts, make sure we correlate with "last_full_sweep_seconds" and restart counts. Also add tags: shard, zone, git_rev.

ops-bot: alert rule created: kvcache_fragmentation_high - fires when fragmentation_ratio > 0.22 for 4h. PagerDuty: on-call -> escalation to infra lead after 1h.

Ibrahim: Who will run weekly check-ins? Need one person to rotate for 4 weeks.

Dmitri: I can take weeks 1+2, Fiona takes weeks 3+4. We'll post minutes and update action statuses.

Fiona: Uploaded baseline heap: s3://redwood-profiles/1972009999/fiona-baseline-1.pb.gz.

Ibrahim: Please update the postmortem doc with PR links and set action statuses to in-progress. We will review in Thurs ops sync. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
